ASYMPTOTICALLY OPTIMAL BINARY LINEAR COVERING CODES
OF RADIUS TWO
JENSEN KOHLMEYER AND LIAM KRUER
ABSTRACT. We construct binary linear codes of covering radius at most two, with lengths tending to infin-
ity and covering densities tending to one. Thus the asymptotic linear covering density satisfies 𝑓 (2) = 1,
answering the radius-two question in the discussion of Green’s Problem 40. The construction proceeds
through binary quadratic maps 𝑄 : 𝑉 → 𝐻, where dim 𝐻 = dim 𝑉 −1. Outside an exceptional subspace of
increasing codimension, every polar map 𝐵𝑄 (𝑎, ·) has kernel { 0, 𝑎} . A finite interpolation operator per-
mits the exceptional codimension to be doubled. The graph of 𝑄 then covers every required sum outside
a smaller subspace; adjoining two complementary subspaces fills the remaining sums at a cost of 𝑜(| 𝑉 |)
points. Taking these points as parity-check columns produces the codes. At iteration 𝑟 the density is at
most 1 + 10 2−2𝑟
. The construction, the density estimate, and the resulting equality have been formalized
in Lean 4 and checked locally against the specified Formal Conjectures target. All proof code is supplied
in one Lean file.
